The '''32nd Commando Unit''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|special forces]] unit. One of the first such units, it was placed under the command of [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Bren Derlin/Legends|Bren Derlin]]. It was assigned to protect [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]].<ref name="RP6">''[[The Thrawn Trilogy Sourcebook]]''</ref><ref name="GW" />
